audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phase sides read 'Pantheon' while the content layer and packet levelChart both read Orianna/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Orianna. The full layer also rated the two-item row as Pantheon's, which contradicts its own why text about late Orianna teamfights.
audit.why: 50.59% over 1269 games is not a lane one side owns from level 1. Level 1 is Orianna's because Shield Vault does not exist until level 2 and Comet Spear is a 575-range poke; levels 2 through first item are a real fight around a point-click stun; two-plus items is Orianna's as Pantheon's single-target dive falls off.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to the content layer, with whys 0-5 rewritten in the same group. phases[6].why already described Orianna winning the row, so it stands as written.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed level 6 doubles your lane presence; breakdown.spikes said the same.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150 at 5500 range — it buys Pantheon map pressure, not a solo kill on you, which is exactly why the row is Skill rather than his. Your own spike is Luden's and then two items.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to name the 180-second ultimate as roam pressure.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions Aegis Assault at all — not its directional immunity, not that it is an interruptible channel, not its 22-second cooldown.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18, 400) makes Pantheon invulnerable to damage from the front and is flagged channel/'interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Two consequences the page owes the reader: damage that reaches him from the side or behind is not blocked, and Shockwave's displacement ends the channel outright. Shield Vault (W, 13/12/11/10/9, 600) is a point-click stun-dash that also resets his attack, so the auto wind-up after it is part of the burst. Comet Spear (Q, 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8) is his only ranged pressure.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dosFull[1].d now carry the front-only immunity, the 22-second cooldown and the 13-second Shield Vault window.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named the ability but gave no number.
audit.why: Shield Vault at 13s rank 1 and Aegis Assault at 22s rank 1 are the two timers that decide when you may stand forward.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with both plus Comet Spear's 11s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood and tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, and dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second' Shield Vault window.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13 seconds at rank 1 and 9 at rank 5 — fifteen is not a rank of anything in his kit, and a reader counting to fifteen steps up two seconds late.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to match their titles; the invitation is now thirteen seconds.

audit.why: The two suspectNames hits ('Shield Vaults' in wants.you[0], "Shield Vault's" in content.mid) are a verb form and a possessive of the correct ability name, not wrong names — false positives, left alone.

notes: All seven full-layer chart sides said Pantheon, against a content layer and packet chart that both say Orianna/Skill x5/Orianna — and against the full layer's own phases[6].why, which describes Orianna winning late. Content was right; only the full sides move, with whys 0-5 rewritten alongside them. Biggest genuine gap: Aegis Assault was absent from the entire page despite being the reason your poke sometimes does nothing — it blocks damage from the front only, and it is an interruptible channel. suspectNames flagged 'Shield Vaults' and "Shield Vault's"; both are ordinary inflections of the correct name and I left them. phases[N].rating untouched — the scale is inconsistent across this dataset (here the enemy-winning rows carry the higher number, elsewhere the owner-winning rows do), so I could not tell what it encodes.
